create_loss_causal_lm: compute cross-entropy loss for causal language modeling with shifted labels and optional num_items_in_batch normalization
create_loss_sequence_classification: compute classification or regression loss from pooled logits and labels with automatic problem type detection
create_loss_question_answering: compute average of start and end position cross-entropy losses for span-based question answering
create_loss_masked_lm: compute cross-entropy loss for masked language modeling with logits and labels flattened to token level
lookup_loss_mapping: look up the appropriate loss function from LOSS_MAPPING by model head name such as ForCausalLM or ForObjectDetection
